trello.desc: The staging deploy job has been red all morning because the CI registry token expired after yesterday's token rotation. Ade will regenerate the registry token, update the CI secret, and re-run the deploy job. Deadline: within one hour. Acceptance criteria: staging deploy job is green and developers can test again.

Owner: Ade. Deadline: end of day today. Acceptance criteria: updated proposal doc with final numbers is sent to Lena by EOD.
